biggest_catch: There is no flat cash bonus — your reward is a percentage of what your referrals earn (15% at Bronze, up to 30% at Platinum), so inactive referrals earn you nothing, and the friend gets no extra referral bonus.
catches: Your referral reward is revenue sharing, not a flat bonus: 15% of your referrals' points earnings at Bronze level, 25% at Gold, and 30% at Platinum.
The friend gets no extra referral bonus from the referral program — they earn 100% of their own points; the revenue share comes from PrizeRebel, not from the friend.
Your revenue-share percentage depends on your account level, which is based on your accumulated points; new members start at Bronze (15%).
There is no cap on referral earnings (per the official article).
Points are redeemed for PayPal cash or gift cards through PrizeRebel's rewards section; exact redemption minimums are account-visible.
No expiry stated; the program is ongoing per the official article.

payout_quote: Official PrizeRebel blog ('Referrals: The Best Way to Earn Points on PrizeRebel'): 'you refer a friend, and from there you will pocket a percentage of everything they earn on PrizeRebel. For Bronze level members, this is 15%, increasing to 25% at Gold, and 30% at Platinum. The percentage you earn from the PrizeRebel referral program does not come out of your friends earnings – they will still make 100% of what they earn, this is just an added benefit for you. Survey sites with referral programs often cap your earnings, but PrizeRebel does not.' Points convert at 100 points = $1 (per third-party redemption docs: $5 minimum for PayPal, $2 minimum for Amazon gift cards).
